hypothesis: Same-clock-hour return continuation (Heston, Korajczyk & Sadka 2010) on ES: the return of an RTH hour on recent sessions predicts the same hour today, from periodic institutional execution (VWAP/TWAP schedules); following it beats side-matched random twins.
mechanism: Execution algorithms and rebalancing desks trade on clock schedules that recur day to day, leaving the same hour with persistent order imbalance for several sessions.

Nearest closed: intraday momentum into the close (first 30m / day return -> last 30m) and close-auction fade; this uses the SAME hour on PRIOR sessions, not today's earlier return. rules.history: for each completed full session (not half_day) and each H: hour return = ln(close of the bar with mod H+55 / close of the bar with mod H-5) (both bars present), and hour range = max(h) - min(l) over the bars mod H .. H+55 (all 12 present). Warmup sessions count. Roll days count as history.
rules.decision: on the bar with mod H-5 (closing at H), no position: mu = mean of hour H's returns over the previous N sessions that have one (needing >= ceil(0.8 N) of the last N full sessions valid); side = sign(mu); no trade if mu == 0.
rules.bracket: stop = c - side*R, target = c + side*R, R = mean of hour H's range over the previous 20 valid sessions (>= 16 of the last 20 full sessions).
rules.exit: {op: exit} on the bar with mod H+50 (closing at H+55) -> flatten at the next open (55-min hold); stop/target first if hit; hour 15:00 ends at the engine flat (15:55).
rules.days: no trades on half_day or roll sessions; warmup ignored by the engine.
rules.control: series='prev_hour' (report only): side = sign(ln close at H / close at H-60), the hour just ended; for H = 10:00 the 09:30-10:00 half hour (ln close of mod 595 / open of mod 570). Same bracket and exit.

count_check: count-only: on_bar fed the dev sessions without the engine (no fills, no outcomes), counting enter actions; configs under 200 dropped, not replaced.
expected_sign: positive mean net R; N = 20 not weaker than N = 1.
against_the_mechanism: Report only (not gated, not in budget): previous-hour control (series='prev_hour'). If it does as well (mean net R within 0.02R or better), this is intraday momentum, not periodicity.
